issues.issue: The 'Local' line is not a tax line. It mixes property and other taxes (6,657,697 on p2) with charges for services (1,669,793 on p2) and keno receipts (Keno Lottery Fund 119,797 on p11). Taxes are the dominant part, so the category is defensible, but taxes (unlabeled) is meant for combined tax lines. The same applies to the detail 'Local' lines (detail[0], [22], [31]).
Inheritance tax is assumed from the fund name. The fund's Local receipts may include interest. The line already carries review.
